title: Does Sycophancy Affect CoT Monitor Reliability? Testing Monitor Flip Rate Under User Pressure

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Interesting connection between sycophancy and monitoring reliability, but the feedback-loop scenario (model told it was flagged, then rewrites) is somewhat artificial. Impact pathway is plausible but indirect.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Bloom can automate scenario generation. Measuring flip rate requires multi-turn prompting and careful protocol design. Bloom itself may have a learning curve for beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Need to define flip rate precisely, generate scenarios, run multi-turn interactions, and score results. Multiple moving parts for 30 hours, but feasible if scoped to one model and one scenario type.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
